verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an official CLI and REST APIs for automation scripts, and Unity Catalog objects can be worked with through SQL, the CLI and REST APIs (schema discovery). Unity Catalog enforces access control and audit logging whenever a table is queried (governance). Agents can also discover, authenticate to and call managed MCP servers that query tables and data, giving a headless path with no dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement-execution API showing results being read back programmatically, explicit CLI/API authentication documentation, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the full end-to-end agent flow.
